\newcommand{\ottdruleQXXHyp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \omega }  \scale \ottnt{Q}   \qtensor    \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \ottnt{q}  }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \ottnt{q}  } }{%
{\ottdrulename{Q\_Hyp}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleQXXProd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q'_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }  \quad  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q'_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \qtensor  \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \qtensor  \ottnt{Q'_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{Q\_Prod}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleQXXEmpty}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \omega }  \scale \ottnt{Q}  }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{  \mathbf{\varepsilon}  } }{%
{\ottdrulename{Q\_Empty}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleQXXDiscardD}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  \scale  \mathcal{L}   }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{  \mathbf{\varepsilon}  } }{%
{\ottdrulename{Q\_DiscardD}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleQXXDupD}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  \scale  \mathcal{L}   }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  \scale  \mathcal{L}    \qtensor    \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  \scale  \mathcal{L}   } }{%
{\ottdrulename{Q\_DupD}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnQrules}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{QF_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Vdash  \ottnt{QF_{{\mathrm{2}}}}$}{\ottcom{Constraint entailment}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleQXXHyp{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleQXXProd{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleQXXEmpty{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleQXXDiscardD{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleQXXDupD{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

\ottdefnQrules{}}

% defns Entail
%% defn Crules
\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXDom}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \Vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \ottlinebreakhack }%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{3}}}} } }%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{3}}}} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_Dom}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXId}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_Id}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXTensor}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} } }%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \qtensor  \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \qtensor  \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_Tensor}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXWith}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}} } }%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \aand  \constraintfont{C_{{\mathrm{2}}}} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_With}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXImpl}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{0}}}}  \qtensor  \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{C} } }%
}{
 \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{0}}}}  }   \vdash   \constraintfont{   \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale( \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Lolly  \constraintfont{C} )  } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_Impl}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleCXXTop}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \vdash   \constraintfont{ \constraintfont{⊤} } }{%
{\ottdrulename{C\_Top}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnCrules}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{QF}  \vdash  \ottnt{CF}$}{\ottcom{Generalised constraint entailment}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXDom{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXId{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXTensor{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXWith{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXImpl{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleCXXTop{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

\ottdefnCrules{}}

\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{=}   \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  }  \forall   \overline{\ottmv{a} } .   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \Lolly  \upsilon  }%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\tau}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]} }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{+}    \multiplicityfont{ \omega }  \scale \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}   \vdash  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}  \upsilon  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\tau}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]}}{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma  \ottsym{,}   \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  } \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}}%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q} }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma  \vdash  \lambda  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{.}  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}   \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \to_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  }  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_Abs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleEXXApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}} }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \to_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  }  \tau }%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}}%
}{
 \constraintfont{ \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \qtensor    \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \ottnt{Q_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  }   \ottsym{;}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{+}    \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}{%
{\ottdrulename{E\_App}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdruleAtomXXOneL}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }   \ottsym{=}   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L}_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{q}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{L}_{{\mathrm{2}}} } }%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }   \notin   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L}_{{\mathrm{2}}} }  }%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }   \notin   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  }%
}{
  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{D} }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }    \vdashsimp    \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }   \scale   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }    \leadsto    \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L}_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{L}_{{\mathrm{2}}} }  }{%
{\ottdrulename{Atom\_OneL}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleAtomXXOneD}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{  \mathcal{L}  }   \notin   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  }%
}{
  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{D}  \ottsym{,}   \mathcal{L}  }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }    \vdashsimp    \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }   \scale   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }    \leadsto    \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }  }{%
{\ottdrulename{Atom\_OneD}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleAtomXXOneU}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }   \in   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  }%
\ottpremise{  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }   \notin   \constraintfont{  \ottnt{D}  \uplus  \ottnt{L}  }  }%
}{
  \constraintfont{ \ottnt{U} }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{D} }  ;   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }    \vdashsimp    \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }   \scale   \constraintfont{ \ottnt{q} }    \leadsto    \constraintfont{ \ottnt{L} }  }{%
{\ottdrulename{Atom\_OneU}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnSolveSimple}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$ \ottnt{UCtxF} ;  \ottnt{DCtxF} ;  \ottnt{LCtxF}   \vdashsimp   \ottnt{piF}  \scale  \ottnt{qF}   \leadsto   \ottnt{LCtxF_{\ottmv{o}}} $}{\ottcom{Atomic constraint solving}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleAtomXXMany{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleAtomXXOneL{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleAtomXXOneD{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleAtomXXOneU{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnsSolve}{
\ottdefnSolve{}\ottdefnSolveSimple{}}

% defns Core
%% defn Core
\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{  \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  }  \forall   \overline{\ottmv{a} } .  \upsilon    \notin  \Gamma }%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}  \upsilon  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\tau}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]}}{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \ottsym{,}   \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  } \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \lambda  \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{.}  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}   \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \to_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  }  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Abs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \to_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  }  \tau }%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}}%
}{
\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{+}    \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_App}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXPack}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\upsilon}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\upsilon}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]}}%
}{
\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{+}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash  \packbox \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{:}   \exists   \overline{\ottmv{a} } .  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \otimes  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Pack}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXUnpack}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   \exists   \overline{\ottmv{a} } .  \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \otimes  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}} }%
\ottpremise{ \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \text{ fresh} }%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{,}   \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  } \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \ottsym{,}   \ottmv{y} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{1} }  } \tau_{{\mathrm{2}}}   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}%
}{
\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{+}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash   \klet\ \packbox (  \ottmv{x}  ,  \ottmv{y}  ) =  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ \kin \  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{:}  \tau}{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Unpack}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXLet}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau_{{\mathrm{1}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{,}   \ottmv{x} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  } \sigma   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}%
}{
  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \ottsym{+}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash   \klet_  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }   \, \ottmv{x}  \ottsym{:}  \sigma  \ottsym{=}  \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{e_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Let}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleLXXCase}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}  \ottmv{T} \, \overline{\tau}}%
\ottpremise{\ottmv{K_{\ottmv{i}}}  \ottsym{:}   \forall   \overline{\ottmv{a} } .   \overline{\upsilon}_{\ottmv{i}}  \to_{  \multiplicityfont{ \overline{\pi}_{\ottmv{i}} }  }  \ottmv{T} \, \overline{\ottmv{a} }  }%
\ottpremise{\Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \ottsym{,}   \overline{  \ottmv{x_{\ottmv{i}}} {:}_{  \multiplicityfont{ \ottsym{(}   \pi {⋅} \pi_{\ottmv{i}}   \ottsym{)} }  } \upsilon_{\ottmv{i}}  \ottsym{[}  \overline{\tau}  \ottsym{/}  \overline{\ottmv{a} }  \ottsym{]}  }   \vdash  \ottnt{e_{\ottmv{i}}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}%
}{
  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }  \scale \Gamma_{{\mathrm{1}}}   \ottsym{+}  \Gamma_{{\mathrm{2}}}  \vdash   \kcase_  \multiplicityfont{ \pi }   \, \ottnt{e} \, \ottkw{of} \, \ottsym{\{}  \overline{\ottmv{K}_i\ \overline{\ottmv{x}_i } \to \ottnt{e}_i }  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{:}  \tau}{%
{\ottdrulename{L\_Case}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnCore}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{e}  \ottsym{:}  \tau$}{\ottcom{Core language}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXAbs{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXApp{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXPack{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXUnpack{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXLet{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleLXXCase{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

\ottdefnCore{}}

\ottdefnsQs
\ottdefnsEntail
\ottdefnsTy
\ottdefnsGen
\ottdefnsSolve
\ottdefnsCore
}
